architecture_review: A narrow model projection port separates grant signing from model authorization (SRP/DIP/ISP). Hub bootstrap remains the composition root; only additive closed metadata changes the existing API. Model policy still uses the existing source resolver/service locator, preserved coupling debt best reduced by injecting a source-authority resolver. Signed metadata is a selection, not execution or release evidence.
scope_boundaries: Actual grant signing and Worker HTTP use explicit synthetic Task/source/model-policy fixtures
Worker execution entry does not yet consume the new selection; no runtime migration or productive inference is claimed
Existing policy-disabled grants preserve compatibility, while withdrawal of an attached policy is a failure instead of downgrade
